description: The columns of the CSV files patient-vitals writes under datacloud/room-readings/ (DATA_CLOUD_EXPORT_PREFIX), in file order, with the Data Cloud type to give each when creating the data stream and the field of the Room_Readings data model object each maps to. test/lambda/patient-vitals.test.js fails the checks when the Lambda's columns and these differ. docs/DATA-CLOUD.md explains each step.

columns.name: reading_id
columns.about: deviceId-timestamp: the same id as Patient_Vitals__c.Device_Reading_Id__c, so a reading in both places has one id

columns.name: device_id
columns.about: The AWS IoT Thing name of the board, from the topic it published on

columns.name: serial_number
columns.about: The Thing name again: it is the device Asset's SerialNumber, the field that joins a reading to its Asset

columns.name: reading_ts
columns.about: When the reading was taken, ISO 8601 in UTC; the board's own time when it sends one, otherwise when AWS IoT received it

columns.name: received_ts
columns.about: When AWS IoT received it, ISO 8601 in UTC

columns.name: temperature_c
columns.about: Room temperature in C from the DHT11; empty when the sensor did not read

columns.name: humidity_pct
columns.about: Relative humidity in percent from the DHT11; empty when the sensor did not read

columns.name: room
columns.about: A room or location label, when the board sends one (room or location in its message); empty today
